close_reason: False positive: lifecycle.rs handles Command::Over with continue before dispatch is reached. handle_over_live() correctly returns 430 for unknown msgids.
description: Trigger: client sends OVER <msgid> (message-id argument form). Expected per RFC 3977 §8.3.2: 430 No Article With That Message-ID. Actual: 224 Overview follows + empty dot-terminator. dispatch.rs routes Command::Over(Some(OverArg::MessageId(_))) to Response::overview_follows() instead of Response::no_article_with_message_id(). Standard newsreader clients (slrn, tin) parse the 224 body as zero articles, silently losing the error signal.
title: OVER <msgid> returns 224 empty body instead of 430
